title: Pickleball | Calm Joints
description: A short pickleball kit for between games, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist.
sub: Pickleball is quick at the kitchen and hard on knees, shoulders and feet. Here’s a short kit for between games, and a video assessment with a registered physiotherapist if you’d like to talk through how you move.

hero_image.alt: Four people play pickleball doubles, solid paddles in hand and a perforated ball above the net.
hero_image.author: TheVillagesFL

widget.panel_copy: Picked for pickleball. Opens in the Industry Insider’s Store.

club_nudge.example: For clubs and community or seniors-heavy courts, this supports a fast-growing older crowd dealing with knees, Achilles issues, and falls.
club_nudge.tier1: Display a co-branded QR code. Anyone who books through it gets sessions with registered therapists across the province. The club earns a 25% payout on net revenue from those bookings.
club_nudge.tier2: A co-branded member store at wholesale rates, with physiotherapy built in.
